mini.alien.goal.en: Shoot down 60% of the intruders without losing all hull
mini.alien.goal.zh-TW: 擊落 60% 入侵者，機身別歸零

mini.alien.controls.en: WASD / arrow keys to move, auto-fire

mini.alien.link.en: Nobody has met aliens in orbit, but spacecraft dodge debris and unexpected threats all the time. Better shielding means more hits survived.
mini.alien.link.zh-TW: 目前沒人在軌道上遇過外星人，但太空船常得閃避碎片和意外；護盾越好，能撐的攻擊越多。
